# DeepSeek V Pro — Full Site Content
> Independent publisher, not affiliated with DeepSeek (深度求索).

## Homepage — DeepSeek V3.2 Overview
URL: https://www.deepseekv.pro/

DeepSeek V3.2 is an open source LLM with GPT-5 level reasoning capabilities. Key features:
- DSA (DeepSeek Sparse Attention) mechanism: reduces long text processing cost by 60%, boosts inference speed 3.5x
- 128K ultra-long context window
- Deep Thinking Mode for complex reasoning
- Speciale Enhanced Edition won gold medals in IMO, ICPC international competitions
- Apache 2.0 open source license, commercial use allowed

### Core Benchmarks (V3.2 Standard)
- MMLU-Pro: 85.0
- Cost reduction: 60% vs comparable models
- Inference speed: 3.5x boost

## DeepSeek V4
URL: https://www.deepseekv.pro/deepseek-v4.html

Released April 24, 2026. Two variants:
- **V4-Pro**: 1.6T total / 49B activated parameters, MoE architecture
- **V4-Flash**: 284B / 13B activated parameters, MoE architecture
- Both: 1M token context standard, MIT license

### Key Benchmarks (V4-Pro-Max)
| Benchmark | Score |
|---|---|
| LiveCodeBench | 93.5% |
| Codeforces Rating | 3206 |
| SWE-bench Verified | 80.6% |
| HumanEval pass@1 | 90.8% |
| AIME 2026 | 99.4% |
| MMLU-Pro | 87.5% |
| MRCR 1M (long-context) | 83.5% |
| Chinese understanding | 94.25% |

### Three Architectural Breakthroughs
1. **Hybrid Attention (CSA + HCA + SWA)**: CSA 4:1 compression, HCA 128:1 extreme compression, SWA tracks recent 128 tokens. 1M context FLOPs = 27% of V3.2, KV cache = 10% of V3.2.
2. **mHC (Manifold-Constrained Hyperconnection)**: Maps inter-layer residuals to doubly-stochastic matrix manifold, preventing numerical explosion in ultra-large MoE training.
3. **Muon Optimizer + 32T+ pre-training data**: Aggressive early convergence with precise late-stage refinement.

### Pricing
- V4-Pro: $0.435/MTok input, $0.87/MTok output
- V4-Flash: $0.14/MTok input, $0.28/MTok output

## V3 to V4 Migration Guide
URL: https://www.deepseekv.pro/deepseek-v3-to-v4-migration.html

### Key Date
**July 24, 2026 15:59 UTC** — deepseek-chat / deepseek-reasoner deprecated.

### Model Name Mapping
| Old (deprecated) | New | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `deepseek-chat` | `deepseek-v4-flash` | Non-thinking mode |
| `deepseek-reasoner` | `deepseek-v4-flash` + thinking params | Thinking mode |
| (high-load) | `deepseek-v4-pro` | Flagship |

### Migration Steps
1. Replace `deepseek-chat` → `deepseek-v4-flash` or `deepseek-v4-pro`
2. Replace `deepseek-reasoner` → `deepseek-v4-flash` + `extra_body={"thinking": {"type": "enabled"}}` + `reasoning_effort="high"`
3. Base URL unchanged: `https://api.deepseek.com` (OpenAI) or `https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic` (Anthropic)
4. Context window expands from 128K to 1M — consider simplifying chunking logic
5. Multi-turn: with tool calls, reasoning_content must be passed back fully

### Legacy-to-V4 Pricing
| Model | Input (cache miss) | Output |
|---|---|---|
| deepseek-v4-flash | $0.14/MTok | $0.28/MTok |
| deepseek-v4-pro | $0.435/MTok | $0.87/MTok |

## V4 vs GPT-5.5 vs Claude Opus 4.6
URL: https://www.deepseekv.pro/deepseek-v4-vs-gpt5-vs-claude.html

### One-Line Conclusion
V4 leads open-source coding + Chinese + price (1/10 of Claude); GPT-5.5 wins on math + multimodal; Claude leads long-chain reasoning stability.

### Coding Benchmarks
| Benchmark | V4-Pro-Max | GPT-5.5 | Claude Opus 4.6 |
|---|---|---|---|
| LiveCodeBench | 93.5% | ~90% | ~88% |
| Codeforces Rating | 3206 | 3168 | ~3000 |
| SWE-bench Verified | 80.6% | ~80% | 80.8% |
| HumanEval pass@1 | 90.8% | 90.2% | ~88% |

### Pricing Comparison
| Model | Output per MTok | vs V4-Pro |
|---|---|---|
| V4-Flash | $0.28 | 0.32x |
| V4-Pro | $0.87 | 1.0x |
| GPT-5.5 | $10.00 | 11.5x |
| Claude Opus 4.6 | $75.00 | 86.2x |

## Coding Benchmark Deep-Dive
URL: https://www.deepseekv.pro/deepseek-v4-coding-benchmark.html

### Real Test Cases
1. **GTA6 intro webpage** (Cyberpunk) — Pass, animated + responsive
2. **3D physics receipt** — Partial, needed corrections
3. **Concurrent bug fix** — Strong, threaded solution with GIL analysis
4. **Distributed ID generator** — Strong, Spring Boot + DB segments
5. **SQL injection defense** — Strong, Python/Java/Go examples
6. **Performance refactoring** — Strong, memory usage down 60%

### Tail Task Stability
- 38-task test: V4 average 8.90 (slightly above Claude 4.7's 8.87)
- But: V4 completed 29/38 (76%), Claude 38/38 (100%) — hardest tasks timed out

## 1M Long Context Deep-Dive
URL: https://www.deepseekv.pro/deepseek-v4-long-context.html

### Benchmark
- MRCR 1M: 83.5% (beats GPT-5.5 69.8% at 128K)
- 1M tokens ≈ 1.5M Chinese chars ≈ 750K English words
- Inference FLOPs: only 27% of V3.2
- KV cache: only 10% of V3.2

### Real Cases
1. **970K character mixed-material Q&A** — 7-second response with cross-source pinpointing
2. **240K novel anomaly detection** — Seconds-level style mismatch detection
3. **Financial report analysis** — 5-year cross-period comparison
4. **Contract review** — 100-200 page clause extraction
5. **Code repo understanding** — 50K-100K LoC at once
6. **Medical literature review** — 200+ papers, trend summary

### Caveats
- Multi-turn context forgetting after 15+ rounds
- MRCR 83.5% is retrieval, not necessarily complex multi-step reasoning
- 1M tokens ≈ 1.5M Chinese chars or 750K English words
